en.html:
You must not kill.

Not even one. You must not kill anyone.
en.text:

ja.html:
殺しちゃいけないよ。
　　　　　　一人も、殺しちゃあ駄目だ。
ja.text:
殺しちゃいけないよ。

en.html:
Yes. Yes... No killing. My foster mother's precious teaching. ...But look at the situation! Without killing, could I save her for certain? CERTAIN, not just hope and see!?
Choices

  • I cannot save her.
